summary: The implementation stays within the approved browser-independent contract and its evidence satisfies every declared verification step.
findings: No confirmed defects: valid load/save, missing lookup, invalid versions, fresh frozen save containers, and unmodified adapter failures are covered.
evidence_refs: npm run verify: application 17 tests/100%, inventory 67 tests/100%, Playwright 1/1, static build, JSDoc, file-size passed
residual_risks: Persistence adapters, deep state cloning, and browser save/open UX are deliberately deferred to separate feature tasks.
